summary: This clinical trial studies how semaglutide combined with metformin affects bone health and fractures in people with type 2 diabetes. The study plans to enroll 150 participants aged 50 to 75 years. Researchers will compare a group taking semaglutide with metformin against a control group taking only metformin for 12 months.
